newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker steady amid slack buying interest.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker steady amid slack buying interest.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Wednesday were far apart but stayed stable from Tuesday's quotes, traders said.
Traders said the market remained quiet and volumes were thin. A trader said shipowners were just sniffing around but not really buying.

Majors were quoting 180-cst prices at between $124-$125 per tonne with independents lower at $122. Bunker 380-cst prices were quoted between $119-$120 by majors with independents seen at $118 per tonne. MDO and gasoil were steady at $210-$226 and $235-$240 respectively.
